# PDF dependencies

Vendored, unmodified browser builds:

- html2canvas 1.4.1 — https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas — MIT. Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js
- jsPDF 3.0.4 — https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF — MIT. Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/3.0.4/jspdf.umd.min.js

Copyright and license notices are retained in each JavaScript file. Keeping these assets on the same origin removes the CDN requirement from document generation.
